title: Engraved pavers fundraiser — Broadford Cemetery Trust (draft)
metaDescription: Buy an engraved paver to support new paving in the centre of Broadford Cemetery. Single, double and triple pavers are available.

header.heading: Engraved pavers fundraiser
header.lead: Your donation will be used to build new infrastructure with paving in the centre of our cemetery.

options.heading: Paver sizes and prices
options.intro: Pavers are engraved to your wording and laid permanently in the Broadford Cemetery shelter area. They stay where they are laid — part of the cemetery’s own fabric, walked past and read by everyone who comes through the shelter.
options.caption: Engraved paver options, wording limits, sizes and prices

order.heading: How to order
order.intro: Ordering is currently by printed form, completed and posted to the Trust.

sideNotices.label: What your paver pays for
sideNotices.body: Every paver goes towards the new paving in the centre of the cemetery — the area around the shelter and the niche wall, where families gather and where the pavers themselves are laid.

sideNotices.label: Choosing your wording
sideNotices.body: Wording is limited by the size of the paver: three lines on a single, six on a double, nine on a triple. Spaces count as characters. If you are not sure your wording will fit, send it to us with your order and we will check it before engraving.
